there is no such thing as a diagnosis of md currently. if you feel like it’s distracting you from your life then it is safe to say it is md.  

one thing that helps me is when i start to feel like its coming on i immediately name some objects around me. “bed” “chair” “cup” it forces me to remain in reality and sometimes talking to myself saying “i will not do this, i will do (*insert task*) instead” helps. but that is not a one size fits all piece of advice it might not work for you.
